name: envoplakin

function.text: EVPL is the approved symbol for envoplakin. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in cadherin binding; structural molecule activity; epidermis development.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Colorectal carcinoma; Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: EVPL encodes envoplakin. Its functions include cadherin binding and structural molecule activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving EVPL have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, colorectal carcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
